name: @innis/column-deck
description: Multi-column UI framework: lifecycle, registry, mount/teardown, drag-to-reorder, keyboard shortcuts, mobile back-stack, sessionStorage-backed persistence. Domain-agnostic — every column is a black box.

tasks.check: deno check mod.ts testing.ts src/ tests/ examples/
tasks.example:minimal-host: deno bundle --platform browser --outdir examples/minimal-host/dist examples/minimal-host/main.ts && deno run --allow-net --allow-read jsr:@std/http@^1/file-server examples/minimal-host --port 8088
tasks.lint: deno lint --ignore=cov_profile/,tests/column-lazy-loader.test.ts,tests/column-shell.test.ts,tests/drag-handler.test.ts,tests/keyboard-handler.test.ts,tests/support/column-base-mocks.ts,tests/support/deck-harness.ts && deno lint --rules-exclude=innis/no-type-assertions tests/column-lazy-loader.test.ts tests/column-shell.test.ts tests/drag-handler.test.ts tests/keyboard-handler.test.ts tests/support/column-base-mocks.ts tests/support/deck-harness.ts
tasks.coverage: rm -rf cov_profile && deno test -A --coverage=cov_profile && deno coverage cov_profile --lcov --output=cov_profile/lcov.info && deno coverage cov_profile && deno run --allow-read jsr:@innis/coding-standards@^0.2.3/check-coverage
tasks.ci: deno task fmt:check && deno task lint && deno task lint-exemptions && deno task check && deno task coverage && deno task exports-tested && deno task docs
